Correct. The CSG must prepare Daily Inspection Reports (DIRs) documenting all construction activities, inspections, issues, and decisions for each working day. Construction Activity Log is not the term used in SPP 204-A. The specified document is the DIR. SPP 204-A requires the CSG to prepare Daily Inspection Reports (DIRs) for every working day. DIRs document construction activities, inspection findings, material deliveries, weather conditions, workforce count, and any issues or directives.
